author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
We're back with The Indie Hour Episode Seventy-Five! This series focuses on games you may have never even heard of and gives us an inside look at the wider world of independantly published Tabletop Wargames of all genres.

Looking for an all-in-one Wargame where all you need to do is print the book? Big Starcraft or Fighting Fantasy fan? 4AWAR is a solo-wargaming on the last planet in the universe slowly descending into a black whole where the three ascendant races in the Galaxy fight over the scraps! Let's check it out!

Check out the rules HERE : https://www.wargamevault.com//product/542075/a4war-age-of-oblivion-a-solitare-war-game?affiliate_id=210041
title: The GMG Indie Hour Ep 075 - 4AWAR by CPGames
